Results.ReviewText:
I have owned a Weber grill for over 3 decades and this latest iteration shares the quality and hopefully durability of the previous grills I've owned.  I chose the Spirit II E-310 because it seemed to have the most bang-for-the-buck in this class.  I'm not disappointed with the choice as it compares well to my old Genesis Silver B which I finally had to retire.  Assembly was relatively easy thanks to the included instructions and the available companion video app which further illustrated each assembly step.  If I have any fault with this grill it would be the wheels which are fairly cheap plastic wheels and actually fell off the grill the first time I had to move it.  I was able to put them back on and they've stayed ever since.

All in all, this is a high performing grill with a plenty of features that I'm still getting used to including the Crossfire ignition system.  The grill heats up plenty fast and clean up has been relatively easy.  The metal is a bit thinner than the Silver B but seems to retain heat (in July) well, even when turned to Low.  I'm quite satisfied with my purchase and would do it again.
Results.Title: E-310 Continues Weber Quality and High Performance

Results.ReviewText:
I bought my Spirit II E-310 from Amazon on a Prime Day Special.  The heavy shipping box had clear instructions as to how to open and remove contents.  The instructions for assembly were exceptionally clear and the pieces fit together perfectly.  Extremely well designed and engineered product and packaging.

Even though I previously had a Spirit II two burner, I learned how to properly start up the unit.  The instructions had me slowly open the propane gas tank valve and wait a bit to insure gas lines came upto proper pressure.  Then I cranked up the three burners until the temperature rose to 500.  Then I reduced heat to the cooking temperature.  


I have cooked salmon, chicken and flank steak and all were evenly cooked and the temperature held steady.


What a great product!
Results.Title: What a great product!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
About 2 months ago we bought a Weber Spirit II e310 gas grill and have used it at least 3 times a week since. I found assembly was pretty easy and I did watch a video as well as follow the paper instructions. It took about an hour or two and we had no issues.
I read many reviews and decided on this one for the high ratings and price. The grill has worked very well, it cooks evenly and has enough cooking area to grill several items at once. I haven't found any high or low heating areas. The iron grates are great and clean easily.
So, all in all, I would recommend this highly.
Results.Title: Great grill
